_doc: Background worker cross-turn continuation. Mirrors the real model behaviour captured in a live run: coordinator spawns a background worker (worker_id=cw) via `agent`, continues it with `send_message(worker_id=cw)`, the worker writes alpha.txt then beta.txt across two turns. Coordinator uses worker_id (not the dynamic task_id) to address the worker, so this fixture is deterministic. Match dims: coordinator requests keyed on the goal substring; worker requests keyed on the worker prompt substring — they never collide, so interleaving order does not matter.
_captured_from: live deepseek-chat run; tool-call shapes adapted to use worker_id addressing

fixtures._comment: C1: coordinator turn 0 (no assistant yet). Goal 'continue-marker'. Decides to spawn a background writer.

cw.system_prompt: You are a file writer worker. Use the Write tool to create files with the exact contents specified. Be concise.

arguments.prompt: write-alpha: write the file alpha.txt in the workspace root with contents exactly: aaa

fixtures._comment: W1: worker turn 1 (isolated transcript, turnIndex 0). Worker prompt 'write-alpha', no tool result. Calls Write.
W1b: worker turn 1 close (turnIndex 1, has tool result). Final text so the first turn finishes.

C2: coordinator turn 1. Goal 'continue-marker' is the latest user msg again (agent tool returned task_id). Decides to continue the worker via send_message using the FIXED worker_id (not the dynamic task_id).

arguments.message: write-beta: write the file beta.txt in the workspace root with contents exactly: bbb

fixtures._comment: W2: worker turn 2 (continuation). send_message pushed 'write-beta...' as the latest user msg in the worker transcript. turnIndex 2 (two prior assistant replies from turn 1). Calls Write for beta.txt.
W2b: worker turn 2 close (turnIndex 3, has tool result). Final text so the second turn finishes.
C3: coordinator turn 2. Goal 'continue-marker', turnIndex 2. Final summary (both turns done).

response.content: Continuation complete: the background worker wrote alpha.txt then beta.txt across two turns via send_message.
